$$\overline{R}\,\Theta_K\, S \;=\; \bigoplus_{n\ge 0}\, \overline{R}_n \otimes_K S_n,$$
a standard graded $K$-algebra whose Poincaré series is
$$P(t) \;=\; \sum_{n=0}^{\infty}\, \dim_K \overline{R}_n \cdot \dim_K S_n\;\cdot\, t^n.$$

---

**Step 1 — Hilbert series of $\overline{R}$.**

The polynomial $f = x_1^3+x_2^3+x_3^3$ is homogeneous of degree $3$ and is a non-zero-divisor in the domain $R$. Hence

---

**Step 2 — Graded dimensions of $\overline{R}$.**

Expanding $(1+t+t^2)\sum_{n\ge 0}(n+1)\,t^n$:

| $n$ | $\dim_K \overline{R}_n$ |
|-----|------------------------|
| $0$ | $1$ |
| $1$ | $2+1 = 3$ |
| $\ge 2$ | $(n+1)+n+(n-1) = 3n$ |

So $\dim_K \overline{R}_0 = 1$ and $\dim_K \overline{R}_n = 3n$ for $n \ge 1$.

*Check:* $\dim \overline{R}_3 = \binom{5}{2}-1 = 9 = 3\cdot 3$. ✓

---

**Step 4 — Poincaré series of the Segre product.**

$$P(t) \;=\; \underbrace{1\cdot 1}_{n=0} \;+\; \sum_{n=1}^{\infty} 3n\,(n+1)\;t^n \;=\; 1 \;+\; 3\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} n(n+1)\,t^n.$$

$$P(t) \;=\; \sum_{n=0}^{\infty}\, \dim_K \overline{R}_n \cdot \dim_K S_n\;\cdot\, t^n.$$

| $n$ | $\dim_K \overline{R}_n$ |
|-----|------------------------|
| $0$ | $1$ |
| $1$ | $2+1 = 3$ |
| $\ge 2$ | $(n+1)+n+(n-1) = 3n$ |
